description: Rust knowledge and orchestration skills: review criteria, testing patterns, rustdoc conventions, and the Rust pipeline.

queries.query: Review src/cache.rs for needless clones, unwrap() in library code, and lock contention.
We return Box<dyn Error> everywhere in this library crate. Review the error handling and tell me what's idiomatic.
Check this crate's unsafe blocks and Send/Sync impls for soundness problems.
Review this trait design: one trait with 20 methods that every storage backend has to implement.
Write unit tests for the tokenizer in src/lexer.rs, including the error cases, using rstest.
How do I test an async function that calls tokio::time::sleep without actually waiting?
Add property-based tests for our base64 encode/decode round trip.
Write integration tests in tests/ for the CLI binary's argument parsing.
Add rustdoc comments to every public item in src/lib.rs, with # Errors and # Examples sections.
Our doc tests fail and half the public API is undocumented. Audit the crate's rustdoc.
How do I link to another type in a rustdoc comment so it renders as a link on docs.rs?
Fix the missing_docs warnings in this crate with proper doc comments.
Run the Rust pipeline on this workspace: review, tests, then doc comments, with clippy and test gates.
Take this crate end to end: review it, raise test coverage, and document the public API.
What's the difference between String and &str?
Bump serde to the latest version in Cargo.toml.
Write Go tests for parser.go.
Set up a GitHub Actions workflow that runs cargo build on every push.
Explain Rust lifetimes like I'm five.
Format the crate with rustfmt.
